# Comprehensive Services Catalog

## 1. Roof Inspection Services
Triple G Roofing provides detailed roof inspections with photo documentation for insurance claims, pre-sale home evaluations, and routine maintenance assessments. Our inspections cover:
- Same-day storm damage assessments during severe weather season
- Free, no-obligation inspections for all North Harris County homeowners
- Photo-documented reports formatted for insurance adjuster review
- Pre-sale and pre-purchase home inspections with written condition reports
- Annual maintenance inspections to identify minor issues before they become costly repairs
- Thermal imaging for hidden leak detection (available upon request)
- Detailed shingle condition assessment, including granule loss and wind damage
- Flashing, valley, and penetration seal integrity checks
- Attic ventilation evaluation and moisture damage inspection
- Gutter function and fascia condition reporting

Inspection turnaround: Most reports delivered within 24 hours. Same-day verbal summaries provided on-site.

## 2. Roof Repair Services
We handle all types of residential roofing repairs, from minor leaks to major storm damage. Triple G Roofing completes most repairs within 48 hours of approval, minimizing interior damage risk. Our repair services include:
- Leak repair and shingle replacement (matching existing roof color and style)
- Flashing and valley repair (using rust-resistant galvanized or aluminum flashing)
- Emergency tarping and temporary weatherproofing after storms
- Rotted decking replacement (we inspect and replace damaged OSB or plywood sheathing)
- Ridge cap shingle replacement
- Penetration seal repair (vent pipes, chimneys, skylights)
- Fascia board and soffit repair
- Gutter reattachment and realignment
- Emergency water diversion during active leaks
- Structural repair for truss damage or rafter issues (coordinated with licensed engineers when required)

Materials: We use manufacturer-grade materials that match or exceed the original roof specifications. All repairs carry a 2-year workmanship warranty.

## 3. Attic Ventilation Services
Proper attic ventilation is critical in North Harris County's hot, humid climate. Triple G Roofing designs balanced intake-exhaust ventilation systems that reduce cooling costs, extend shingle life, and prevent moisture-related damage. Our attic venting services include:
- Ridge vent installation (the most effective exhaust ventilation for Texas climates)
- Soffit vent installation to ensure proper intake airflow
- Balanced intake-exhaust ventilation system design (following the 1:300 rule)
- Gable vent installation for additional airflow in specific roof configurations
- Powered attic fans (installed only when passive ventilation is insufficient)
- Attic insulation assessment and recommendations
- Moisture barrier installation to prevent condensation buildup
- Temperature reduction strategies to lower HVAC load

Benefits: Homeowners typically see 10-15% reductions in summer cooling costs after proper ventilation upgrades. Shingle life can extend by 3-5 years when attic temperatures are properly managed.

## 4. Gutter Installation Services
Triple G Roofing installs seamless gutter systems custom-fit to your home's roofline. Proper gutter function protects foundations, prevents fascia rot, and directs water away from landscaping. Our gutter services include:
- Seamless gutter systems (no joints to leak)
- Custom-fit gutter runs measured and fabricated on-site
- Foundation and fascia protection through proper water diversion
- Low-maintenance aluminum construction (rust-resistant, paintable)
- 5-inch and 6-inch gutter profiles (6-inch recommended for heavy Texas rainstorms)
- Downspout placement and extension installation
- Gutter guard installation (optional, recommended for heavily wooded areas like Kingwood)
- Slope optimization for proper drainage
- Hidden hanger systems for clean aesthetics

Materials: We use .032-gauge aluminum gutters with a baked enamel finish in standard and custom colors. All installations include sealed end caps and rust-resistant fasteners.

## 5. Roof Damage Repair Services
Beyond minor repairs, Triple G Roofing handles comprehensive roof damage restoration. This includes rotted decking replacement, full section re-roofing, and structural repair to bring roofs back to code. Our damage repair services include:
- Full damage assessment and repair planning
- Rotted decking replacement (we remove and replace damaged OSB or plywood sheathing)
- Comprehensive structural repair for truss damage, rafter issues, or ridge sagging
- Underlayment replacement (synthetic underlayment for superior waterproofing)
- Valley reconstruction and flashing upgrades
- Chimney flashing and cricket installation
- Skylight seal replacement or removal
- Built to North Harris County building codes and manufacturer specifications
- Coordination with structural engineers when required for major repairs
- Insurance documentation and claims support

Warranty: All structural repairs carry a 5-year workmanship warranty. Materials carry full manufacturer warranties.

## 6. Storm & Wind Damage Roof Repair
North Harris County experiences frequent severe weather, including hail, high winds, and heavy rainstorms. Triple G Roofing provides emergency response for storm-related roof damage, with same-day inspections during storm season. Our storm damage services include:
- Emergency response for hail and wind damage (same-day inspections available)
- 24/7 emergency availability during severe weather events
- Emergency tarping and temporary weatherproofing to prevent interior damage
- Direct insurance billing and claims coordination
- Photo-documented damage reports formatted for insurance adjuster review
- Adjuster meeting coordination (we meet with adjusters on-site to advocate for complete repairs)
- Hail damage assessment (dimpling, granule loss, mat damage)
- Wind damage assessment (lifted shingles, blown-off ridge caps, exposed fasteners)
- Water intrusion mapping and interior damage documentation
- Rapid repair turnaround to restore weatherproofing

Claims Advocacy: We work directly with insurance companies to ensure homeowners receive full coverage for legitimate storm damage. Our detailed documentation and adjuster coordination minimize claim denials and underpayments.

# Service Area — Detailed Local Knowledge

## Huffman, TX (Home Base)
Huffman is our home base. We understand the unique challenges of Huffman's rural-suburban mix, including:
- Larger lot sizes (often 1-5 acres) with mature trees creating roof debris challenges
- Clay-heavy soil that causes foundation movement and roof stress
- Proximity to Lake Houston and the San Jacinto River, increasing humidity and moss growth risk
- Frequent severe weather from Gulf Coast storm systems
- Mix of older homes (1960s-1980s) requiring careful repair-vs-replace evaluations

## Humble, TX
Humble features a mix of historic downtown homes and newer developments. We've completed dozens of projects in Humble, including:
- Fall Creek subdivision (1980s-1990s homes entering re-roof cycle)
- Downtown Humble historic homes (specialty repairs preserving architectural integrity)
- New developments along FM 1960 and Will Clayton Parkway
- Understanding of Humble's clay soil foundation movement impact on roof structures
- Experience with Humble ISD area HOA requirements and architectural guidelines

## Atascocita, TX
Atascocita sits on the western shore of Lake Houston, creating unique weather challenges:
- Rapid-onset severe weather from thunderstorms rolling off the lake
- High wind exposure (70+ mph gusts common during spring/summer storm season)
- Golf-ball-sized hail risk
- Steeper roof pitches common in 1980s-1990s developments (Eagle Springs, Kings River)
- HOA compliance experience in master-planned communities
- Understanding of lake-climate humidity and ventilation requirements

## Kingwood, TX
Known as "the Livable Forest," Kingwood's mature tree canopy creates specific roofing challenges:
- Constant debris accumulation from pine and hardwood trees
- Moss growth in shaded areas
- Limb damage risk during windstorms
- Strict HOA roofing standards in Woodland Hills, Kings Point, and the Greens
- Architectural review board submission experience
- Gutter guard recommendations for heavily wooded properties
- Sandy, well-drained soil (less foundation movement than Humble)

## Crosby, TX
Crosby's rural-suburban mix includes larger properties with agricultural buildings:
- Residential shingle roofing for homes
- Metal roofing for workshops, barns, and garages (standing-seam, corrugated, 5V-crimp)
- Newport area and FM 2100 corridor (1-5 acre properties)
- Barrett Station historic community (respectful service for heritage homes)
- Higher wind exposure than wooded areas (upgraded fastening schedules required)
- Sandy loam soil with good drainage

# Common Questions Answered (Expanded)

**How quickly can you repair storm damage?**
Triple G Roofing offers same-day inspections for storm damage during severe weather season. We work directly with insurance adjusters to expedite the claims process. Most repairs begin within 48 hours of insurance approval. During major storm events, we prioritize emergency tarping and temporary weatherproofing to prevent interior damage, then schedule permanent repairs as quickly as materials and labor allow. Our emergency crews are on standby for Huffman-area homeowners during severe weather.

**What roof materials work best in Huffman's climate?**
Impact-resistant shingles, architectural asphalt shingles, and metal roofing all perform well in the hot, humid Texas Gulf Coast climate with frequent hail and wind exposure. Impact-resistant (Class 4) shingles qualify for insurance discounts and withstand hail better than standard shingles. Architectural shingles offer good value and 25-30 year lifespans. Metal roofing excels for longevity (50+ years) and heat reflection but costs more upfront. We assess each home's specific exposure, budget, aesthetic preferences, and HOA requirements to recommend the best option.

**Do you handle insurance claims?**
Yes. Triple G Roofing provides detailed estimates that meet insurance adjuster requirements, communicates directly with adjusters, and bills insurance companies whenever possible — so homeowners avoid large out-of-pocket expenses. We document all damage with photos, provide written reports, meet adjusters on-site, and advocate for complete repairs (not just partial patch jobs). Our experience with insurance processes minimizes claim denials and underpayments.

**What warranty comes with a new roof?**
Triple G Roofing guarantees 10 years of workmanship on all installations — significantly longer than the industry standard 1-2 years. Shingles carry manufacturer warranties of 25-30 years (lifetime on premium lines). Metal roofing carries 40-50 year manufacturer warranties. As a manufacturer-authorized installer, warranties remain valid even after the job is complete. We also provide no-charge follow-up inspections at 1 year and 3 years to catch any minor issues before they escalate.

**How often should I inspect my roof?**
Annual inspections are recommended for North Harris County homeowners, plus an extra inspection after any major storm (hail, wind gusts over 60 mph, or heavy rain). Many insurance claims are denied because damage wasn't documented quickly enough. Prompt inspection protects both the roof and the homeowner's ability to file a valid claim. Triple G Roofing offers free, no-obligation inspections — we recommend scheduling one in early spring before peak storm season.

**How much does a new roof cost in North Harris County?**
Costs vary by roof size, pitch, material choice, and damage extent. As a general range:
- Asphalt shingle re-roof: $8,000-$15,000 for typical 2,000-2,500 sq ft homes
- Impact-resistant shingle re-roof: $10,000-$18,000
- Metal roof installation: $15,000-$30,000
- Roof repairs: $300-$3,000 depending on damage extent
Insurance often covers storm damage repairs minus the deductible. We provide free estimates and work with homeowners to find solutions within their budget.

**Do you offer financing?**
We work with several financing partners to offer flexible payment options for homeowners. Contact us for current financing programs and approval process details.

**Are you licensed and insured?**
Yes. Triple G Roofing is a Texas Licensed Roofing Contractor and carries full liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage. We provide proof of insurance upon request and ensure all work meets North Harris County building codes.

**What's the difference between repair and replacement?**
Repairs make sense when damage is localized (one section, a few shingles, a single leak). Replacement is recommended when:
- The roof is over 20 years old and showing widespread wear
- Multiple leaks exist across different areas
- More than 30% of the roof is damaged
- Shingles are curling, losing granules, or showing mat damage across the entire roof
We provide honest assessments and never recommend replacement when repair is adequate.

**How long does a roof installation take?**
Most residential re-roofs are completed in 1-3 days depending on size, pitch, and weather. Tear-off, installation, and cleanup are completed efficiently to minimize disruption. Complex roofs with multiple valleys, dormers, or steep pitches may take longer.

Common claim outcomes: Most legitimate storm damage claims result in approval when properly documented. Triple G Roofing's detailed reports and adjuster coordination minimize denials.

# Climate & Weather Considerations
North Harris County's Gulf Coast climate creates specific roofing challenges:
- Heat: Summer attic temperatures exceed 150°F without proper ventilation
- Humidity: 70-90% humidity accelerates shingle aging and promotes moss growth
- Hail: Golf-ball to baseball-sized hail common during spring/summer severe weather
- Wind: Tropical storms and Gulf fronts bring 60-80 mph wind gusts
- Rain: 50+ inches annual rainfall with intense downpours during storm events
- UV exposure: Intense Texas sun degrades organic roofing materials over time

Triple G Roofing designs every roof to withstand these conditions through proper material selection, ventilation, and fastening schedules.

# Environmental & Energy Efficiency
We offer energy-efficient roofing solutions that reduce cooling costs and environmental impact:
- Cool-roof shingles with reflective granules (lower attic temperatures by 10-15°F)
- Radiant barrier installation (reflects heat away from living spaces)
- Proper attic ventilation (reduces HVAC load and extends shingle life)
- Metal roofing (reflects heat, lasts 50+ years, fully recyclable)
- Reclaimed materials recycling (we recycle tear-off shingles whenever possible)

Energy savings: Homeowners with cool-roof shingles and proper ventilation typically see 10-20% reductions in summer cooling costs.
